limits: Only small, representative synthetic tasks. Native total tokens include cached input; they are not invoices or independent API-request counts.
An explicitly named nonmodel fixture supplied unrelated traffic. Two real agents were used, not three independent product functions.
Controlled result delays provide reproducible timing; they are not external-service or performance benchmarks.
No compaction occurred in these current runs. Earlier real compaction evidence does not qualify the current continuous reader policy with pending input.
No phone, push, multihost, long-running commercial delivery or autonomous enterprise readiness is established.
N=1 per matched scenario and a candidate-only requalification do not establish stochastic reliability or general superiority.

nextExecutableSlice.objective: Prove continuation from standing responsibility after a prior task is already complete.
nextExecutableSlice.reconcileFirst: Inspect existing canonical role, Goal/Work and portfolio supervision paths before adding any mechanism. A room observation can currently amend unfinished work; it cannot simply be accepted as a new assignment.
nextExecutableSlice.journey: Give one explicit durable responsibility, finish an initial artifact, then let another real agent publish a new relevant verified fact after completion alongside unrelated traffic. Require appropriate autonomous follow-up without another human prompt. Attribute authority to the standing responsibility, not the incoming message.
nextExecutableSlice.followingGate: Exercise actual native compaction with pending input, then repeat representative comparisons using the same durable work contract and a single-history control.
nextExecutableSlice.preservation: No user-stopped owners or schedules, no all-default cutover, no new semantic coordinator or shadow work ledger.
